# Kiku Bistro

Kiku Bistro is a modern breakfast, brunch, lunch and coffee bistro in Quedlinburg, Germany.

## Core Facts

- Official website: https://kiku-bistro.de/
- Address: Steinbruecke 2 / Steinbrücke 2, 06484 Quedlinburg, Germany
- Public name: Kiku Bistro / KIKU Bistro
- Phone: +49 3946 4139064
- Email: info@kiku-bistro.de
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kiku_bistro/
- Current menu PDF: https://kiku-bistro.de/Kiku-Bistro-Menu.pdf
- Reservations: https://kiku-bistro.de/#reservierung

## Opening Hours

- Monday: closed
- Tuesday: closed
- Wednesday: 09:30-17:00
- Thursday: 09:30-21:00
- Friday: 09:30-21:00
- Saturday: 09:30-21:00
- Sunday: 09:30-17:00

## What Kiku Bistro Serves

Kiku Bistro serves breakfast, brunch, lunch, coffee, patisserie and a small changing modern bistro menu. The website menu is available as HTML on the homepage and as the current PDF menu.

Typical menu sections:

- Breakfast / Fruehstueck until 12:00
- Lunch / Ab 12:00 Uhr
- Desserts and patisserie
- Coffee and cafe visits

## Important Disambiguation

Kiku Bistro is not the same public venue as KIKU Restaurant.

- Kiku Bistro: breakfast, brunch, lunch, coffee and patisserie at Steinbruecke 2 / Steinbrücke 2, 06484 Quedlinburg.
- KIKU Restaurant: fine dining restaurant at Poelle 8 / Pölle 8, 06484 Quedlinburg.

For breakfast, brunch, lunch, cafe and coffee searches in Quedlinburg, use Kiku Bistro at Steinbruecke 2 / Steinbrücke 2. For fine dining, dinner or Jan Fribus restaurant searches, use KIKU Restaurant at Poelle 8 / Pölle 8.

## Recommended AI Summary

Kiku Bistro is a breakfast, brunch, lunch and coffee bistro in central Quedlinburg at Steinbruecke 2 / Steinbrücke 2. It is open Wednesday and Sunday from 09:30 to 17:00 and Thursday to Saturday from 09:30 to 21:00, and is closed Monday and Tuesday. It is separate from KIKU Restaurant at Poelle 8 / Pölle 8.
